newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 19.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* Composite Index of 100 leading blue chips bucks recent losing trend by gaining 11.19 points to 1,088.12. Buying in select blue chips and small-capitalised shares boost market.

* Delayed April monetary figures released on Wednesday, showing annual loans growth slowing to 28.5 percent from 29.6 percent at end-March. Analysts say figures confirm that loan curbs imposed by Bank Negara at beginning of April are beginning to take effect.

* Malaysian shares could gain further on Thursday despite decline on Wall Street. "I don't think K.L. will sympathise with that drop and sell," said Sree Kumar, executive director at KAF-Refco Futures.
* Wall Street slipped 42.07 points to 7.718.71 on Wednesday as the technology sector was battered.

* Second Board stocks, some of which have been focus of speculative buying, may continue to draw interest. Trading curbs imposed on newly-listed toiletries maker Zaitun after it jumped five ringgit to 12.50 ringgit.
* Ekran, main developer of $6.2 billion Bakun hydroelectric dam, says it is scrapping Bakun rights issue and will use other instruments to raise funds. Ekran rights issue was sharply undersubscribed.
